title: Three-SAT belongs to polynomial space
statement: The language of binary strings whose decoded CNF formula has at most three literals per clause and is satisfiable is decidable by a finite Turing machine that, on every input of length $n$, halts with the correct single-bit answer while using at most $C(n^c+1)$ work-tape cells, for some natural numbers $C$ and $c$.
